expiry_time_minutes.title: Expiry Time Minutes
expiry_time_minutes.description: The time that the reservation is active. When making a booking, this should be set to something low like 10 (the minimum). For expiry times less than 2 hours, there will be no cooldown when the reservation expires.

send_notifications.title: Send Notifications
send_notifications.description: If true, will send notifications, when the reservation is about to expire, and when it has expired. If false, no notifications will be sent regarding the reservation. When making a booking, this should be false.

error_on_existing_reservation.title: Error On Existing Reservation
error_on_existing_reservation.description: If true, will return an error if the user already has a reservation for the Treet. If false, will return the existing reservation id.When making a booking, this should be false.

save_treet.title: Save Treet
save_treet.description: If true, will set the treet as saved for the user. If false it will not set it. Should be false, when booking.
